task.title: Starting Diesel Engine at Cold
task.shortdesc: If engine coolant is cold, engine low idle speed could be higher than normal condition.

step.cmd: Turn the ignition key to the ON position. The start preheat light will come ON. The preheat light will stay ON maximum 20 seconds, depending on the ambient temperature.

info.note: Do not crank more than 10 seconds continuously.
info.p: If engine coolant is cold, engine low idle speed could be higher than normal condition. (Electronic Engine)

step.cmd: After the preheat light goes OFF, turn the ignition key to the START position, with the accelerator pedal pressed.
Release the ignition key after engine starting and check the engine condition.
If the engine stalls or does not start, turn the ignition key to the OFF position, then repeat steps 1 thru 3.
